I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot because one bag costs too much and is meant for a much bigger field than my 0.14 hectares. We will put manure from our animals on this land instead, since we have it at home and it keeps the soil good without spending cash. I will plant the same seed we saved from last season because I know it grows here, and I do not want to waste money on new seed for such a small piece. My mother and I will do all the work ourselves, and I think it will take about twenty days from planting to harvest.
